description.en: Libya, officially the State of Libya, is a country in the Maghreb region of North Africa. It borders the Mediterranean Sea to the north, Egypt to the east, Sudan to the southeast, Chad to the south, Niger to the southwest, Algeria to the west, and Tunisia to the northwest.
description.zh-CN: 利比亞國，通稱利比亞，是位於北非的國家。與埃及、蘇丹共和國、乍得、尼日尔、阿爾及利亞和突尼西亞相鄰。
